title: Water Washed Bedrock Ore
description: Ores can be washed to increase the number of primary products and even add useful additional byproducts. Washing is done in &3Ore Acidizers&r with different fluids.
Ores straight out of the &3Bedrock Ore Processor&r (before initial centrifuging) can be washed with &bWater&r to immediately duplicate all products, making it a very desirable first step.
